caption: Two lit white taper candles stand in clear glass holders with blue bases on a speckled tile floor against a pale wall and baseboard, their flames flickering and casting a warm glow and soft shadow upward. A hand holding a green plastic cup enters from the upper right, lowering the cup's opening toward the rear candle's flame. The hand keeps the cup tilted just above and to the right of that flame, making small approach and retreat movements while its shadow shifts on the wall. The cup never touches the candle, and both flames remain lit. The hand then lifts the cup up and out of the top edge, leaving the two burning candles in view.
